title: [shared_preferences] shared_preferences_android 2.5.0 crashes release builds at start: NoSuchMethodError in SharedPreferencesAsyncApiRegistrar.getAll (R8)
body:
### Steps to reproduce

1. `flutter create --platforms android repro && cd repro`
2. `flutter pub add shared_preferences` (resolves `shared_preferences` 2.5.5 and `shared_preferences_android` 2.5.0)
3. Replace `lib/main.dart` with the code sample below.
4. `flutter build apk --release` (R8 is on by default for release builds) and install/run the APK on a device or emulator, e.g. `flutter run --release`.

### Expected results

The app opens the preferences, shows the first frame and counts launches, as it does with `shared_preferences_android` 2.4.28 and as it does in debug and profile builds with 2.5.0.

### Actual results

`SharedPreferencesWithCache.create()` throws at start in the release build, so `runApp()` is never reached and the app stays on the splash screen. Debug and profile builds work, and iOS is not affected.

`shared_preferences_android` 2.5.0 calls its Kotlin code through JNI (flutter/packages#12329). The JNI bindings of the plugin and `package:jni` 1.1.0 (`lib/src/kotlin.dart`) look up Kotlin classes by name: `kotlin.coroutines.Continuation`, `kotlin.Unit`, `kotlin.Result`, `kotlin.Result$Failure`, `kotlin.coroutines.intrinsics.CoroutineSingletons` and `kotlin.coroutines.intrinsics.IntrinsicsKt`. R8 renames them, and neither the plugin (it has no consumer ProGuard rules) nor `jni` (its `consumer-rules.pro` keeps only `com.github.dart_lang.jni.**`) keeps them. `SharedPreferencesAsyncApiRegistrar` itself survives thanks to `@Keep` (flutter/packages#13151), but R8 rewrites the descriptor of its `getAll` with the renamed `Continuation`, so the descriptor that the Dart bindings use no longer exists. From `build/app/outputs/mapping/release/mapping.txt`:

```
kotlin.coroutines.Continuation -> o1.d:
```

Workarounds that make the release build work:

- constrain the Android implementation: `flutter pub add 'shared_preferences_android:>=2.4.28 <2.5.0'`, or
- keep the Kotlin classes in `android/app/proguard-rules.pro`:

```
-keep class kotlin.Unit { *; }
-keep class kotlin.Result { *; }
-keep class kotlin.Result$Failure { *; }
-keep class kotlin.coroutines.Continuation { *; }
-keep class kotlin.coroutines.intrinsics.CoroutineSingletons { *; }
-keep class kotlin.coroutines.intrinsics.IntrinsicsKt { *; }
```

Related: flutter/flutter#193880 (closed; the generated classes got `@Keep`, and its PR notes that the Kotlin rules stay needed until `jni` ships them) and dart-lang/native#3732 (open; `jni` should keep these classes).

### Code sample

<details open><summary>Code sample</summary>

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final preferences = await SharedPreferencesWithCache.create(
    cacheOptions: const SharedPreferencesWithCacheOptions(),
  );
  final launches = (preferences.getInt('launches') ?? 0) + 1;
  await preferences.setInt('launches', launches);
  debugPrint('launches=$launches');
  runApp(MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('$launches')))));
}
```

</details>

### Screenshots or Video

_No response_

### Logs

<details open><summary>Logs</summary>

```console
E flutter: Unhandled Exception: PlatformException(PlatformException, java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: no non-static method "Lio/flutter/plugins/sharedpreferences/SharedPreferencesAsyncApiRegistrar;.getAll(Ljava/util/List;Lio/flutter/plugins/sharedpreferences/SharedPreferencesPigeonOptions;Lkotlin/coroutines/Continuation;)Ljava/lang/Object;"
...
#3      SharedPreferencesWithCache.create
```

Seen on an Android 17 (API 37) arm64 emulator with an arm64 release APK.

</details>

references.title: [shared_preferences] Keep Kotlin classes used through JNI in Android release builds
[shared_preferences_android] Add proguard rules for internal Kotlin types
[shared_preferences] configure consumer rules to fix R8 breakage
